title.zh: 将拉瑙省马拉邦市镇科库埃拉堡的名称变更为Jose Abad Santos堡的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Fort Corcuera in the Municipality of Malabang, Province of Lanao, to Fort Jose Abad Santos
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Fort Corcuera in the Municipality of Malabang, Province of Lanao, to Fort Jose Abad Santos

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1637_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Fort Corcuera in the Municipality of Malabang, Province of Lanao, is changed to Fort Jose Abad Santos.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1957.
